title: Cruise Control Operation and Controls
summary: Feedback on cruise control centers on some owners appreciating active cruise performance and long-trip usefulness, while many other comments are requests or questions about how the controls work and what features are available.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise active cruise control as useful on long trips and satisfying in everyday operation.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe adaptive cruise as overly frequent in steering-wheel nag alerts and confusing in the distinction between set and resume controls.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mainly reflect questions, feature wishes, and unclear operational issues around engaging, resuming, follow distance, and understanding cruise functions.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, which limits confidence about overall sentiment beyond the specific examples shown.
Several undetermined examples describe questions, wishes, or ambiguous operation rather than clear praise or complaints.
Positive evidence is limited in the supplied examples, so the favorable summary should be read as illustrative rather than comprehensive.
